text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending a short-duration parking zone on the west side of Zorra Street south of The Queensway, as approved as part of site plan approval for the development located at 1197 The Queensway.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 20 minutes, at all times on the west side of Zorra Street, between a point 25 metres south of The Queensway and a point 15 metres further south.
